messages:
leo-people-ops: Heads up: launching an Evidence Fast-Track option for the Q2 SOC2/ISO window. Goal = reduce friction for small services and feature teams that have straightforward controls.

anya-eng: How is this different from previous "compact" lanes?

leo-people-ops: Fast-Track is even more prescriptive: a 7-file max bundle + a short manifest. Were providing a template and a checklist so reviewers can triage in one pass.

maria-privacy: Important note: acceptance criteria unchanged. Fast-Track is for intake speed only; teams may still get requests for more evidence.

ben-platform: Will we get automated linting on the manifest?

attestation-bot: New intake schema v2.1 will validate fields: service_name, repo_link, control_manifest.md, primary_owner, change_window_link. Auto-lint scheduled on upload.

anya-eng: That sounds helpful. What about training/attestations?

leo-people-ops: No new mandatory training. BUT: people who completed security/privacy training within last 8 months can use the "micro-attest" quick form (5 questions). Eligible folks will receive an invite email from attestation-bot.

zoe-hr: Contractors: you must confirm the manager-approved list in the intake or we wont accept Fast-Track bundles from contractor-only teams.

anya-eng: Where do teams upload?

leo-people-ops: Evidence Portal -> choose "Fast-Track Intake Q2 2026". Follow the naming convention: <team>-fasttrack-q2-2026.zip. Put the manifest at root called control_manifest.md.

maria-privacy: Tag uploads with: SOC2-Q2-2026, ISO-Q2-2026, and the owner alias. Well run spot checks and may request deeper artifacts for certain controls (esp. identity and change management).

ben-platform: Quick ask for the team: can the manifest include a direct link to the primary CI pipeline run for the artifact? That will speed verification.

leo-people-ops: Yes, please include pipeline_run_link in the manifest. Well add it to the template.

anya-eng: Office hours?

attestation-bot: Office hours Wed/Thu 16:00-17:00 UTC (link: https://meet.example.com/fast-track). Intake window opens in 3 days; first deadline 2165007200 (one week).

leo-people-ops: Also: were publishing a one-page checklist you can pin to repos. Ill post the PR and notify the repo-owners channel.

zoe-hr: Reminder: if you want micro-attest eligibility checked manually, DM me with your training completion date.

leo-people-ops: TL;DR: Evidence Fast-Track = 7-file max + manifest + same validation rules; micro-attest for recent trainees; portal + office hours link above. Please read the template before uploading. :sparkles:
